# Font preview test fixture

`Hack-Regular.ttf` is the unchanged font bundled with `epaint_default_fonts`
0.33.3. It exercises real TrueType outline decoding, rasterization and the
Session Font preview path. This test-only file is not embedded in the application
or copied into release ZIPs.
